description.value: Uncle Pu's Sichuan Taste (蒲大叔川菜) is a Sichuan Chinese restaurant on West Broadway in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, serving bold spice-forward dishes rooted in Sichuan province cooking traditions. The menu spans mapo tofu, fish fillets in hot chili oil, braised offal, Szechuan-style wontons and noodles, and tonkotsu ramen, alongside a small range of bottled retail sauces. It sits on a well-travelled cycling corridor connecting downtown Vancouver to the western neighbourhoods.
